map.多伦多西部痉挛性斜颈评分量表，评估颈部肌张力障碍严重程度，含运动/失能/疼痛三个: Toronto Western Spasmodic Torticollis Rating Scale, assesses cervical dystonia severity, with motor/disability/pain subscales
map.TWSTRS 颈部肌张力障碍总分 = 严重程度 + 致残 + 疼痛三部分之和，满: TWSTRS cervical dystonia total = severity + disability + pain, max 75; <=20 mild, <=40 moderate, <=60 mod-severe, >60 severe.
map.D. 旋转偏斜持续时间（一天中）: D. Rotational deviation duration (over a day)
map.2 - 中度影响，工作稍困难: 2 - Moderate effect, slightly hard to work
map.肉毒素注射+口服药物，评估DBS: Botulinum injection + oral medication, assess DBS
map.TWSTRS是痉挛性斜颈最常用的严重程度评估量表，含运动(35分)、失能(30分: TWSTRS is the most common severity scale for spasmodic torticollis, with motor (35), disability (30), pain (20) subscales. Botulinum injection is first-line, a drop >=10-15% is effective. Drug-refractory dystonia may consider DBS of the globus pallidus internus.
map.抽动障碍运动、残疾、疼痛三维评分。: Tic disorder motor, disability, pain three-dimensional scoring.
map.A 型肉毒/行为治疗随访。: Type A botulinum / behavioral therapy follow-up.
map.运动 18+残疾 14+疼痛 3=35 /50：抽动重度，明显影响功能。: Motor 18 + disability 14 + pain 3 = 35 /50: severe tics, markedly affect function.
map.合计 12 /50：轻度，以简单运动抽动为主。: Total 12 /50: mild, mainly simple motor tics.
map.运动 8 项 + 残疾 6 项 + 疼痛 2 项，合计 50。: Motor 8 items + disability 6 items + pain 2 items, total 50.
map.反映抽动相关疼痛（如颈部肌张力障碍），常作次要维度。: Reflects tic-related pain (e.g. cervical dystonia), often a secondary dimension.
